sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:49

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:49:1
items.html: The Land of Israel, which was opposite Yetzira, does not receive from it except through Assiya. For before the sin, Yetzira was in the place of Beria and of the Nukva of ZA: the first four in the place of the Nukva of ZA, and the six lower ones in the place of the six upper ones of Beria. It follows that the Land of Israel, which is opposite Yetzira, was then receiving from the Beria of now. And after the sin, the first six of Yetzira fell into the Assiya of that time, and the four lower ones of Yetzira fell to the place of the shells, for from the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzira downward, and the ten Sefirot of Assiya, fell to the dwelling of the shells, which is from the Chazeh of the place of BYA downward, as above. It follows that the Land of Israel cannot receive from the discernment corresponding to it, which is Yetzira, except through the Assiya of before the sin, that is, according to the state that existed in the first discernment, at the time of the birth of Adam HaRishon.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:49:2
items.html:
And likewise, Beria clothes in Yetzira, and the Nukva of Atzilut clothed in Beria, and ZA clothed in his Nukva, etc.: For Beria, which had been standing in the place of ZA of Atzilut, descended because of the sin to below the Parsa, to the place of the six lower ones of Yetzira of before the sin, that is, in the state that existed at the time of the birth of Adam HaRishon. And ZA, who had been standing in the place of upper Aba, descended to the place of the Nukva, that is, to the discernment of from his Chazeh [chest] downward, which belongs to his Nukva, and he became the discernment of VAK [six ends] without a Rosh [head].
Thus, the state of the worlds before the sin, that is, in the first discernment, at the time of the birth of the soul of Adam HaRishon — and this state is the principal one — was this: ZA was in the place of Aba, and his Nukva in the place of Ima; Beria in the place of ZA; Yetzira — its GAR [first three] in the place of the Nukva of ZA, and its VAK in the place of the first six of Beria; and Assiya — its first four in the place of the four lower ones of Beria, and its VAK in the place of the six upper ones of Yetzira, down to the Chazeh. And after the sin, ZA fell to the discernment of from his Chazeh downward and became VAK without a Rosh, and the Nukva to the discernment of a point; Beria fell below the Parsa, to the place of the six lower ones of Yetzira and the first four of Assiya of that time; Yetzira fell to the place of the six lower ones of Assiya and the first four of the dwelling of the shells; and Assiya fell entirely, down to the ten Sefirot of the dwelling of the shells. And know that these four lower ones of Yetzira, from her Chazeh downward, which fell to the dwelling of the shells, are sometimes called by the name Malchut of Yetzira, because everything from the Chazeh downward of any degree whatsoever is regarded by the name Malchut.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:49:3
items.html: His body is from this world; his Nefesh from Assiya; and his Ruach from Yetzira, from the place where his body was at first. For the body of man is always from Malchut of Assiya, which is called dust, from which the external garment over his NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] was made, as above, page 1913, the passage beginning “And behold.” And before the sin, when the world of Assiya was in the place of the first six of Yetzira, down to the Chazeh [chest], the discernment of his body too was made of the discernment of Yetzira of now, for the lower one that rises to the place of the upper one becomes like it. And after he sinned with the Tree of Knowledge, and all the ten Sefirot of Assiya fell to the place of the shells, as above, his body was made from this world, which is the discernment of Malchut of the world of Assiya of now. And his Nefesh was made from the nine first ones of Assiya, and his Ruach was made from the world of Yetzira of now, which is in the place of the six lower ones of Assiya of that time. And likewise, his Neshama was made from the Beria of now, which is in the place of the six lower ones of Yetzira of that time. And the NRN of Atzilut that he had before the sin, as above — these were lost entirely. You should also know that these NRN of Beria that the ARI mentions do not mean that they remained in him so after the sin, for after the sin there remained in him only Nefesh of Nefesh, as the ARI writes in the Gate of the Verses, Bereshit, Siman 2; see there. Rather, the intention is that after he repented, he again attained NRN from BYA.
